networks.name: caretaker_checkin
networks.description: Read a calm daily note and approve a gentle check-in. Nothing is sent automatically.
sample_queries: How does this morning compare with the usual routine?
Draft a gentle check-in for me to approve.
What is a check-in, and do you watch video?

networks.name: care_glossary
networks.description: Explain check-in drafts and metadata without reading a household.
sample_queries: What is a check-in, and do you watch video?

peer_policy.note: The glossary is same-origin. Any other origin needs a visible approval before its manifest is fetched. A visitor key is sent only to the selected router.

agent_mcp.reason: Care data stays in the visitor's browser. This site does not expose a public MCP facade.

deployment.note: The agent graph runs in the browser. A same-origin proxy can forward an optional visitor key to an OpenAI-compatible router. That proxy does not substitute a publisher key when a visitor key is present, and it does not send the key to peer sites.
